newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia needs 13 new pulp plants - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia needs 13 new pulp plants - newspaper.

text.p: Indonesia needs at least 13 new pulp plants to achieve its production target of 10 million tonnes in 2003, the Bisnis Indonesia daily reported on Tuesday.
The director-general of agricultural and forestry products, Sujata, was quoted by the newspaper as saying the additional plants were badly needed as current annual output was only 3.6 million tonnes.
At least 13 new plants with an annual production capacity of 500,000 tonnes are needed to meet the country's output target of 10 million tonnes in 2003, he said.
Sujata cited huge capital costs in setting up pulp plants as a possible obstacle to achieving the target.
He did not say how many pulp plants there were in Indonesia. Industry analysts were not immediately available for comment.
